ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Pluto

s.k: Look after your nest and the people in it.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your image and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Put a plant or fresh flowers in your home.

s.k: The right words open doors today.
t: Ideas come pouring in. Write them down: not all of them are for today, but some will be worth gold later on.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your inner life and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Read a few pages of a book instead of spending the time on your phone.

s.k: Security is built in small steps.
t: The Moon passes through your area of money and security. It is a good day to look at your accounts calmly and without fear.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, friendships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
s.d: Review this week's spending and cut one thing you do not need.

t: With the Moon in your sign, your intuition is sharper than usual. Trust what you feel at first impression.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your career and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Do something for yourself that you have been putting off for weeks.

t: With the Moon in your house of silence, dreams and intuition bring answers. Watch for the signs.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, your horizons and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Walk alone and listen to your own thoughts.

s.k: The future takes shape in good company.
t: The Moon favours sharing and helping one another. What you give to others comes back to you in other ways.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, intimacy and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Join a cause or help someone in need.

s.k: Think of the summit, climb one step.
t: Others notice your effort. Do your best, even in the tasks nobody applauds.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, relationships and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Dress like the person you want to be at work.

t: The Moon passes through your area of horizons. You feel like learning, travelling or simply seeing things differently.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, routine and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Look at a problem as if someone else were seeing it.

s.k: Let go of what no longer belongs to you.
t: Today is a day to let go of what weighs you down: a resentment, a habit, an old distrust.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, romance and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Ask yourself what you are afraid of losing, and why.

s.k: A day to get in step as a pair.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, family and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Share a meal with someone important to you.

t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, conversations and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Make a short list of three tasks and get them done.

s.k: A day to create, play and feel.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.

The sextile between Mercury and Pluto brings together, in your favour, money and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Pluto brings depth and transformation. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Go for a walk with no destination and no hurry.
